newsitem.title: USA: Robinson Nugent Q2 incoming orders off.
newsitem.headline: Robinson Nugent Q2 incoming orders off.

text.p: Robinson Nugent Inc said incoming customer orders fell six percent in its December 31 second quarter to $20.3 million from $21.6 million in the same year-ago period.
For the six months, customer orders were $41.3 million, up $300,000 or one percent. Backlog of unshipped orders at December 31, 1996 amounted to $16 million, up from $15.8 million a year ago.
In light of a slowing market growth rate, president Larry Burke said the company's strategy is to continue to reduce inventories and to cut manufacturing costs.
Earlier Friday the manufacturer of electronic connectors and integrated circuit sockets reported a second-quarter profit of $0.03 a share compared to a year-ago loss of $0.01 a share.
